title: Money & currency
body:
Japan runs on cash more than its cashless reputation suggests, and this trip leans further that way than a Tokyo-only itinerary would. The Hanagasa Bus to Ginzan Onsen takes cash only, and Ginzan Onsen itself has no ATM or convenience store in town.

7-Eleven and Japan Post ATMs in Yamagata city both accept foreign cards. Withdraw what you'll need for the Ginzan Onsen leg (bus fares, incidentals, any cash-only ryokan) before leaving the city — the nearest ATM from Ginzan Onsen is roughly 30 minutes away by car.

title: Budget & daily costs
intro: Per-person estimates. The Ginzan Onsen ryokan night is priced separately since it runs far above a city hotel (it includes a multi-course dinner and breakfast, standard for the format) — figure sourced from an aggregator comparison, not the ryokan's own current rate card, so treat as approximate.

items.label: Lodging, Yamagata city hotel (2 nights)
items.note: Two city nights only (Oct 20 and 21) — Oct 22 is the Ginzan Onsen ryokan, priced separately below. Around ¥7,000/person/night, business/mid-range near Yamagata Station; not individually verified

items.label: Lodging, Ginzan Onsen ryokan (1 night, dinner + breakfast included)
items.note: ≈¥30,800/person is the lowest plan listed for Ginzanso (2-guest room, tax included, dinner + breakfast) on a booking agent, not the ryokan's own rate card — confirm at booking

items.label: Food & drink, per day
items.note: Soba/casual lunches run ≈¥1,500-2,500; the Yonezawa Beef Tokiwa dinner alone is ¥9,900/person minimum

items.label: Local transport, per day
items.note: Senzan Line to Yamadera (≈¥260 each way), the Hanagasa Bus (¥1,000 each way) on the Ginzan Onsen day, plus city buses/taxis

items.label: Sights & activities, per day
items.note: Most Yamagata city culture/history stops are free; Yamadera admission is ¥500

items.note: Not researched this pass — depends on the international departure airport, which intake left blank

items.note: ≈¥11,450 each way in an ordinary reserved car (¥6,050 base fare + ¥5,400 express charge). Every Tsubasa seat is reserved — book all 8 together. ⚠ Confirm the exact figure at booking
